about.title: About ArkAgentic
about.subtitle: We build reliable, transparent, and scalable AI infrastructure so companies can safely access top global and China-native models, then convert AI capability into measurable business outcomes.

what.title: What We Build
what.body: ArkAgentic provides a production-grade OpenAI-compatible gateway and model routing platform. China-based teams can reliably use top global models, while global teams can efficiently access leading China-native models. We focus on resilient routing, transparent pricing, observability, and governance for long-term operation.

story.title: Our Story
story.body: Our founding team brings over a decade of management and execution experience across major technology companies, investment banking, and consulting. Across real-world projects, we repeatedly saw the same blocker: organizations wanted AI adoption, but were constrained by integration complexity, unstable routing, unpredictable cost, and cross-region model access. ArkAgentic was built to productize that infrastructure complexity.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: Help more organizations and individuals benefit from trustworthy AI. We believe AI value should be measured by practical outcomes: higher operating efficiency, lower cost, faster decision-making, and sustainable customer growth.

smb.title: AI Growth for SMBs
smb.body: Beyond the gateway platform, we work with small and mid-sized businesses to deploy AI and agentic workflows across core operations. We deliver repeatable solutions for efficiency, cost optimization, and growth conversion, so AI becomes a compounding capability rather than a one-off experiment.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: ArkAgentic provides an enterprise-grade privacy program designed for Australian, United States, and global compliance requirements across AI inference operations.

baseline.title: Enterprise Security & Zero Data Retention Baseline
baseline.p1: ArkAgentic enforces in-memory (RAM-only) processing for model inference. Prompt and completion payloads are processed for response generation and destroyed immediately after completion.
baseline.p2: No persistent disk write retention, no prompt log storage, and 100% prohibition on using customer prompts or completions for AI model training are enforced as platform baseline controls.

compliance.title: Global Regulatory Compliance Framework
compliance.intro: Our compliance controls are aligned to major privacy and security frameworks used by enterprise legal and procurement teams:
items: Australia Privacy Act 1988 and Australian Privacy Principles (APPs): transparent processing controls and data sovereignty alignment.
United States standards: architecture aligned with SOC 2 Type II controls and CCPA/CPRA requirements, with US East data sovereignty routing controls.
EU GDPR alignment: support for GDPR Article 28 processor obligations and enterprise DPA (Data Processing Addendum) workflows.
International security references: ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27018 cloud data protection practices.

dataProcessed.title: Data We Process
items: User Identity Data: Name, Email, and Account Tier for registration, authentication, and account administration.
Billing and Telemetry Metadata: token counts, API latency, and anti-abuse diagnostics for billing, quota control, and reliability operations. Prompt content itself is excluded from telemetry storage.

residency.title: Data Residency & Cross-Border Guardrails
residency.body: Inference traffic is routed by approved Enterprise Cloud Regions (for example, US East) with strict controls that prohibit non-compliant cross-border transfer unless legal and compliance review is explicitly satisfied.

rights.title: Data Subject Rights & Enterprise Requests
rights.body: Customers may request data access, export, correction, and deletion. Enterprise customers can initiate DPA-linked legal review and processing records requests through ArkAgentic privacy operations.

contact.title: DPO & Privacy Contact
contact.body: For privacy incidents, legal requests, or regulator-facing compliance communications, contact our privacy operations team.
